headRoom.run: This conversation continues in ucx run, in the terminal. You can read it here, but not write in it.
headRoom.loop: This conversation continues in ucx loop, in the terminal. You can read it here, but not write in it.
headRoom.acp: This conversation continues in the editor that opened it. You can read it here, but not write in it.
headRoom.a2a: This conversation continues with the agent that called this clone. You can read it here, but not write in it.
headRoom.other: This conversation continues in another program. You can read it here, but not write in it.

row.silentFinished: {label} finished this turn without sending any text.
row.silentStopped: {label} stopped partway through this turn and sent no text.
row.unsaved: {label} will not remember this turn after a restart; it could not be saved.
row.sessionSetAside: This version could not open {label}'s earlier conversation here. It was kept, not written over, and {label} carried on without it.

knowledgeLearned.one: {label} will remember 1 thing from this turn.
knowledgeLearned.other: {label} will remember {count} things from this turn.

row.knowledgeExtractFailed: {label} could not pick up what to remember from this turn.

header.autonomousOnTitle: Autonomous discussion active (agents converse while you view)
header.autonomousOffTitle: Turn on autonomous discussion (agents converse while you view)

invite.noClones: No clones are running yet. Send a message in a chat first, and whoever answers can be added here.
invite.everyoneHere: Everyone available is already in this conversation.

empty.noOne: No one is in this conversation yet. Add someone to get a reply.
empty.nothingSaid: Nothing has been said here yet. Send a message to start.

notices.ceiling: Paused after {count} replies. Send a message to continue.
notices.silence: No one answered your last message, and no one is going to. Address someone with @ to get a reply.

notReset.one: {names} still remembers what was removed here, so a reply may refer to it. Send a message to start again, or clear this conversation.
notReset.other: {names} still remember what was removed here, so a reply may refer to it. Send a message to start again, or clear this conversation.

reset.saturated: {names} reached the {threshold}-turn limit on context. Shorten this conversation to keep going, or start a new one.
reset.fromRecord: Counted from the saved record for {names}, which nothing has spoken in since this server started.
reset.compactBlocked: A turn is running. Shortening waits until it finishes, so nothing is cut out from under it.

question.one: Clear this conversation? Its one message is removed for good. It keeps its name and who is in it.
question.other: Clear this conversation? Its {count} messages are removed for good. It keeps its name and who is in it.

clearConfirm.blocked: A turn is running, so this would be refused. It can be done once that finishes.

refusalRemedy.budget_exceeded: Trying again would be refused too. Start a new conversation to continue.
refusalRemedy.model_without_tools: Pick a model that supports tools (for example qwen3:8b) in Settings, then send your message again.
refusalRemedy.model_unavailable: Choose another model in Settings, then send your message again.
refusalRemedy.provider_auth: Paste a new API key in Settings, then send your message again.
refusalRemedy.usage_limit: Raise the limit in Settings → Usage, or switch this clone to a local model, then send your message again. Settings → Usage shows when paid models can be used again.

outcome.refusalRemedyOther: Trying again would be refused for the same reason.

refusalReason.budget_exceeded: it has used all the tokens this conversation allows
refusalReason.model_without_tools: its model can't use tools, which clones need
refusalReason.model_unavailable: no model is chosen for it, or the one chosen is not available from the provider
refusalReason.provider_auth: the provider did not accept the API key
refusalReason.usage_limit: you've reached your usage limit for paid models

outcome.refusalReasonOther: the app refused to run it

providerRemedy.provider_unreachable: If you set a custom endpoint in Settings, check that address too.

outcome.stopped: {label} was stopped before finishing this turn.
outcome.wentWrong: {label} couldn't finish this turn because something went wrong while it was answering.

memoryNoneSaved.one: {label} tried to save something to memory, and nothing was saved.
memoryNoneSaved.other: {label} tried to save {count} things to memory, and none of them were saved.

memorySomeUnsaved.one: {label} tried to save {total} things to memory, and {count} of them was not saved.
memorySomeUnsaved.other: {label} tried to save {total} things to memory, and {count} of them were not saved.
